runtimeNotes.summary: Expanded supplier and retailer backend route coverage in apps/backend-go with optional Firebase-protected retailer role row.
Expanded driver and warehouse backend route coverage in apps/backend-go with Firebase-role-gated driver/warehouse paths and cookie-admin fallback for warehouse scaffold mode.
Expanded factory and payload backend route coverage in apps/backend-go with Firebase-role-gated factory/payload paths and cookie-admin fallback scaffold mode.
Expanded payment and webhook backend route coverage in apps/backend-go with idempotency-backed payment mutations and signature-first webhook handling.

Expanded advanced factory/payload workflow coverage in apps/backend-go: factory manifest lifecycle transitions + rebalance/cancel/exception queue, and payload manifest lifecycle + exception handling + reassignment apply depth.
Expanded shared event contracts with advanced manifest workflow types (MANIFEST_ORDER_INJECTED, MANIFEST_ORDER_EXCEPTION, MANIFEST_DLQ_ESCALATION, MANIFEST_REBALANCED, MANIFEST_CANCELLED).

Hardened payment webhooks to provider-exact signature formats (Global Pay Basic auth, Stripe Stripe-Signature t/v1, Adyen item-level hmacSignature) and moved factory/payload manifest mutations behind repository Apply seams with outbox emit, cache invalidation, and websocket fanout parity.

Added manifest payload contract parity in scaffold handlers: MANIFEST_SEALED envelopes now include route/driver/vehicle/order_count metadata, and payload reassignment envelopes include from/to manifest and route metadata with source+target manifest cache invalidation.

Activated scaffold reliability lifecycle in backend-go: main now starts outbox relay + cache invalidation subscriber, repositories persist buffered outbox events into relay-readable memory store, and trace middleware propagates X-Trace-Id into outbox event payload context.

Activated production-adapter bridge in backend-go: bootstrap now attempts Redis cache backend and Kafka outbox publisher with in-memory/logging fallback, and websocket hubs relay typed fanout envelopes with source-instance suppression while main starts all hub relay subscribers.

Added strict reliability mode in backend-go bootstrap: REQUIRE_INFRA_ADAPTERS enforces fail-fast startup when Redis or Kafka adapter initialization fails; default mode remains fail-open fallback for local scaffold runs.

Bound outbox relay authority to Spanner OutboxEvents when available: bootstrap now probes Spanner and selects outbox.SpannerStore for relay fetch/mark with in-memory fallback, and strict-mode adapter startup behavior is covered by bootstrap tests.

Activated request reliability middleware in backend-go: main mounts bootstrap reliability controls after trace middleware (fixed-window rate limits, priority shedding, per-class circuit-open responses), gated by RELIABILITY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED with dedicated middleware tests and emulator-gated Spanner outbox integration coverage.

Activated payment execution routing seam in backend-go: payment service now routes checkout/chargeback/reversal through payment/execution.go with bounded retry/backoff+jitter for retryable provider failures and typed gateway policy errors, with AIRWALLEX direct execution controlled by AIRWALLEX_DIRECT_EXECUTION_ENABLED.

Added checkout attempt execution persistence in backend-go/payment: checkout now writes PaymentAttemptRecord via repository SaveAttempt and surfaces additive attempt_id/execution_action/execution_mode/provider_reference metadata in checkout response and payment-required event payloads.
